fixture.note: Explicit density fixture adds normal enemies through spawnEnemy and preserves initial enemies, spawnClock, HP, speed, AI, damage and normal subsequent spawning. Existing Continue/preload/resume UI launches the memory-only checkpoint.

native.note: Original native texture submission and shader API readiness before launch; not GPU completion, measured FPS or first-draw validation. A maximum of three original enemy models is owned until adoption.

attribution.note: QA-owned Renderer observation only. Inclusive method spans overlap and must never be summed; selfMs subtracts only completed direct observed child spans, and buckets sum those self spans within an observed renderer.render call. renderer.render self is the remaining unwrapped render work, including observer overhead. Readiness snapshots are taken at frame boundaries, not construction times or guarantees of GPU readiness. floorReady reports surface existence only; floorWorldCached reports a stored world-cache owner, not cache freshness for a particular Game. Factory source/type classification uses bounded own-data fields and does not query GL or invoke metadata getters. drawPlayer is the current renderer's outer player draw; it has no drawNativePlayer method. No Canvas API hooks, draws, renders, pixel reads, loads, uploads, priming, ticks, event drains, storage or scheduling calls are added. CPU call wall includes synchronous waits and instrumentation overhead; it is not GPU execution time, presented FPS or peak memory. Use without overlapping external method profilers or candidate installers.

report.note: Explicit qa-render-attribution=1 plus own-data originalAttribution:true: original A1/A2 only, with the same owned preparation, normal180 checkpoint, forty fixed callbacks, literal equivalence and strict whole-canvas AA gate. No Canvas state candidate or candidate installer is constructed. A lazily imported outer-method profiler observes original calls only; its begin/end/restoration overhead is included in callback/render wall. Inclusive and exclusive spans are distinct; never add parent and child durations. Two original arms are attribution diagnostics, not a performance-win or adoption comparison. 8851 genuine-memory QA only. Fresh owned Renderer/Art/native player and initial max-three-model NPC preparation per original A1/A2 arm. Original on-demand species loads remain enabled; actual runtime model/pending maxima are reported. Main ready records are borrowed by identity and never loaded, masked or released through a mutating path. Forty fixed .12-second catch-up callbacks include their first draw; batch-eight rAF yields are reported separately. This is a renderer combat harness without app HUD, audio or persistence, not presented FPS. No Canvas-stage or other frame/native observer is installed alongside the attribution profiler. Literal per-frame checkpoint/effects/motion/commands/events and both RNG states are compared outside timers. Final whole-canvas readback and PNG export follow the measured loop. Existing twelve-state/two-selected-cell pixel QA is separate evidence, not proof for every source frame. Shared URL decode caches and the live product caches remain resident; fresh instances do not imply cold driver/URL caches. Owned native pending promises are followed through late success/failure for retirement. A failed player Promise.all can have unobservable sibling requests; that failure is explicitly cleanup-unproven rather than called complete. Timings are CPU call wall, not GPU duration or peak memory. No product optimization is adopted by this utility.
